# proxmox_node_ceph_config_raw (Data Source)

Reads the raw Ceph config from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/cfg/raw`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_config_raw" "c" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `raw` (String)
